item.title: Working at Dollar Tree as a Cashier: Pay, Pros, Cons & What to Expect
item.description: The definitive 2026 guide to working as a Dollar Tree cashier — real pay by state, what the job actually involves day-to-day, scheduling reality, pros and cons, tips, and a full comparison with Dollar General, Family Dollar, Five Below, and the now-closed 99 Cents Only.
